proposed_edit.new_declaration:
private theorem commutator_sup_left' (H K N : Subgroup G) [(⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆).Normal] :
    ⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · -- map to the quotient where both commutators vanish
    have hH : ⁅H, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_left
    have hK : ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_right
    -- `simp` handles the kernel / map_eq_bot bookkeeping
    rw [← QuotientGroup.ker_mk' (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆), ← Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff,
      map_commutator, Subgroup.commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer] at hH hK ⊢
    simpa [map_sup] using sup_le hH hK
  · exact sup_le (commutator_mono_left le_sup_left) (commutator_mono_left le_sup_right)

candidates.requested_change: Replace the `rw [map_sup]; exact ...` tail with `simpa [map_sup] using ...` (keeping the same earlier `rw ... at ... ⊢`).
